colour.status: Five identity-resolved Japan-local continuous-lightness concepts are now available. The population-matched continuous history pilot is unlocked; discrete W/C/polymorphism transition direction remains blocked.

priority_reordering.first: Immediately run the five-concept population-matched continuous-lightness history using JPN17/JPN23/JPN30/JPN36/JPN37, the canonical Japan38 tree, exact 120 label permutations and leave-one-out sensitivity.
priority_reordering.second: Treat a negative or unstable five-concept result as a real result and expand local concept coverage; do not search for a different post hoc threshold or trait transform.
priority_reordering.third: Only after the Japan-local continuous signal is characterized should colour be discretized, and only with an independently frozen W/C/polymorphism ontology plus topology/reticulation sensitivity.

priority_reordering.do_not_repeat: Do not lower the 0.55 confidence floor, count multiple photos from one observation/locality as independent populations, or promote JPN05 until a second independent locality passes.

claim_boundary: The fifth-concept gate unlocks a Japan-local continuous-colour proxy history pilot only. It does not establish a discrete white/coloured state, ancestral colour, transition direction, convergence, adaptation, molecular reactivation, or adaptive radiation.
